content.comment_body: I have a [product_name] [version_no]. If I transfer the saved program from the memory card of a damaged module into another one, does the replacement need to be the exact same version of the [product_name] [version_no] module?
Yes, it is possible. However, if the new [product_name] is not the same series as the old one, communication via [product_name] software may not work.

analysis.insight_summary: The forum discusses whether memory cards with saved programs can be interchanged between different versions of [product_name] [version_no] modules. There is uncertainty about compatibility and communication when transferring a program from a damaged module to another module, especially if their versions differ. Users feel there is a lack of clear guidance about version-specific compatibility and related communication concerns.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope to transfer programs between [product_name] [version_no] modules without encountering issues related to version mismatches or communication problems.
